Fuel the hunt.

Minifig Hunt is free and has no ads. A coffee keeps it that way.

Hi, I am the one collector behind this site. I built it because I wanted every Collectible Minifigures series in one place, with every figure, one at a time.

Hosting, the domain and the evenings spent adding each new wave cost a little. If the site helped you finish a series, a coffee is a lovely way to say thanks.
